title: Stochastic Models for the 3x+1 and 5x+1 Problems
notes: docs/problems/juggler_jump_spectrum.md. Read at the stopping-time section. Theorem 2.2 restates Terras and Everett: the set with finite lambda-stopping time has natural density one. Its proof sketch carries an independent cross-check on this laboratory's theta -- the decrease occurs 'for all but an exponentially small set of patterns, of size O(2^(0.94995k)) out of 2^k possible patterns', and 0.94995 is H(beta) = log_2(2 theta) = 0.94995552718833063481. Rate only: no polynomial correction, no oscillation, no constant. Generalizations attributed to Rawsthorne 1985 and Borovkov-Pfeifer 2000.
